School Zone Repair and Occupancy Schedule

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited occupancy schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, and at least 1 IfcSlab entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, CLASSROOM-3, COMMON, STAFF, WC-CHILD, WC-STAFF, STORE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [18.0, 10.0, 3.0].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: RoomNumber, RoomName, OccupancyCategory, OccupancyLoad, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 8 data rows in this order: R01 CLASSROOM-1 Teaching 12.0 30.0, R02 CLASSROOM-2 Teaching 12.0 30.0, R03 CLASSROOM-3 Teaching 12.0 30.0, R04 COMMON Common 12.0 30.0, R05 STAFF Support 2.0 12.0, R06 WC-CHILD Support 2.0 6.0, R07 WC-STAFF Support 2.0 6.0, R08 STORE Support 2.0 8.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, SCHOOL ZONE REPAIR AND OCCUPANCY SCHEDULE, CLASSROOM-1, COMMON, STORE.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
